items.summary: Animals, like humans, are taking up increasing amounts of tiny plastic particles. Such microplastics are demonstrably hazardous to many species under experimental conditions, and it is suspected that they may also pose a threat to animals in the wild. While data about microplastic concentrations in the terrestrial environment exist, it has not yet been clear if higher exposure also translates into higher microplastic accumulation in individual animals. A new paper published in Nature now confirms this link.

All molecules wishing to pass through must thread their way through one of several thousand nuclear pores. The scaffold structure of these pores is well known. However, exactly how transport takes place within them has been the subject of much debate. Researchers at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU), the Max Planck Institute for Biophysics (MPI-BP) in Frankfurt am Main and Wuhan University in China have now shed light on the matter.

Kirk Cousins trades the Raiders for the Vikings, landing exactly where his Achilles tear ended his last stint. The irony is thick, but the stats show he's still a starter. The Las Vegas Raiders sent Cousins to the Vikings on Tuesday, just before the clock hit the deadline. Adam Schefter of ESPN reports that Minnesota is surrendering a third-round selection in the 2027 NFL Draft to acquire him. It is a clean swap for a veteran who still has gas in the tank. Cousins played nine games for Vegas this season, throwing for 2,340 yards and 20 touchdowns. He was good enough to force a move that clears the path for a rookie.

LSU Tigers coach Lane Kiffin is urging his players to embrace criticism and respond on the field after a disappointing 31-13 loss to Alabama, but his message has also sparked questions about accountability within the program. A lengthy statement addressed to every player and employee appeared on television screens throughout LSU's football facility Monday, two days after the Tigers suffered arguably the worst loss of Kiffin's short tenure. While this addressed the criticism that comes with playing for one of college football's notable programs, it encouraged players to ignore outsided opinions and avoid making excuses and return to work.

Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova dismantles Coco Gauff to become the first player to reach the last four at the WTA Finals. Czech Noskova played with controlled aggression and served brilliantly to beat the American 6-3 6-3. World number eight Noskova was composed throughout and broke Gauff's serve four times in the first set alone. She sent powerful winners to all corners to outmuscle her opponent, who is one of the best movers on the WTA Tour, and committed only one unforced error in a dominant second set. The 21-year-old fittingly sealed victory with an ace to secure a place in the semi-finals on her tournament debut.

A seven-time Gold Glove winner and World Series champion, the legendary catcher forged a rare three-generation dynasty that defined excellence behind the plate and in the dugout. Boone managed Cincinnati from 2001 until he was fired during the 2003 season, finishing with a 190-238 record. His time in the dugout was a relatively small part of a career that had already established him as one of the more accomplished defensive catchers of his era. Boone played 19 Major League seasons and finished with seven Gold Glove Awards and four All-Star selections. He also ranks third all-time in games caught, with 2,225, trailing only Hall of Famers Iván Rodríguez and Carlton Fisk.

The conflict in the Gulf is an opportunity for the US to test its autonomous mine-hunting systems. Traversing the Strait of Hormuz remains one of the most dangerous trips a vessel can take. Double amputee Zaher told the BBC last year about his favourite footballer and a dream of being able to walk again. In a dark room in Cairo, a 13-year-old boy looks up at a television screen, barely blinking. The screen flickers and Real Madrid's superstar winger Vinícius Júnior appears addressing the young boy directly, in Arabic: "Zaher, mahaba" - Hello Zaher. We first met Zaher a year ago in the ruins of Sudan's capital, Khartoum. He was a small quiet child, scarred by war - one of millions of children whose lives have been upended since the country's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) started fighting in 2023.

Forecasters warn that this year's El Niño could be one of the strongest on record, with heavy rain and flooding in Kenya. "It flooded up to here in March," Agnes Shikoli says, pointing to a spot halfway up the six-foot [1.8m] corrugated iron wall of her home in Kibera, one of the largest informal settlements in Kenya. Her tiny house lies just a couple of metres from the Ngong river, which runs through this densely populated area in the capital, Nairobi. The scars of floods in the long rainy season earlier this year can still be seen - including a broken TV in the corner which was immersed in water.

Sonia Gandhi's memoir revisits love, loss and political inheritance, offering a deeply personal defence of her family and its legacy. India correspondent Published 2 minutes ago On the morning of 31 October 1984, Sonia Gandhi was a young wife and mother, living in the prime minister's residence in Delhi. She was about to take a bath when she heard shots ring out in the garden. Her mother-in-law, Indira Gandhi, India's prime minister, had just left for her office in an adjoining building. Ole Miss football fell in the CFP rankings after a home loss to Georgia. Here's where Trinidad Chambliss and the Rebels settled Ole Miss was No. 10 in the initial poll last week, which was in the 12-team CFP bracket. The reason for the nine-place drop was a 42-7 home loss to No. 1 Georgia. There are 12 places in the CFP, with five reserved bids and seven at-large bids. Four places go to the highest-ranked conference champions. A fifth spot will be reserved for the highest-ranked non-Power 4 team. If the non-Power 4 team is outside the top 12 in the CFP poll, it means the team ranked No. 12 in the CFP poll will be bumped from the bracket. No. 24 Boise State is that team this week.

The top eight teams get byes in the first round of the expanded playoff next season. Currently, the top four teams in the 12-team playoff get a first-round bye while Nos. 5-12 play each other across four first-round games. In 2027, the top eight seeds will get a bye, while teams Nos. 9-24 will play each other over eight first-round games. But even though the field is bigger, the Group of Six isn't guaranteed more representation. Just one of the 23 spots will be reserved for a Group of Six conference champion. Any other G6 team will have to make it as an at-large.

The LPGA is adding more fines in addition to stroke penalties for players in 2027 for slow play The policy for the timing method and stroke penalties is the same, but more fines have been added. In the past, each time a player finished one to five seconds over the allotted time, it was a warning, and now it will be a fine in 2027. If a player finishes six to 15 seconds over, it previously was a one-stroke penalty and now a fine is added. If a player's time is 16 seconds or more over the allotted time, it's still a two-stroke penalty but now also a fine.

An audio drama workshop has brought blind and partially-sighted people together to create a new play. A box of gravel, a handful of leaves and a miniature door might not sound like the ingredients for a wedding day drama. For a group of blind and partially-sighted people, an audio-based drama workshop is giving them the chance to explore performance - without relying on visual cues. Instead, they are using sound to create characters, settings and stories, building a picture in the audience's mind without showing them a single image.

The transition to electric vehicles should be moving apace, but it is not. And why? Incompetence, expedience and cowardice, says Guardian columnist George Monbiot T his is how it works. It argues that a transition would threaten jobs, or damage the national interest, or harm poor people, while what it really fears is the cost of retooling its plants or developing new protocols. The NBA approved new lottery rules in May. In May, team owners approved the new "3–2–1" draft lottery system , which will take effect by the 2027 draft. The system further flattens the lottery odds, expands the lottery from 14 to 16 teams, and includes a relegation zone that gives the three teams with the worst records worse odds at the top pick than teams that finished with the fourth-to-tenth worst records. The belief was that more teams would enter the season with the desire to compete, with some positing that the effect could be a larger middle class and a smaller gap between the teams at the top and bottom of the standings.

However, because of Home Office delays, I did not receive my five-year refugee permission until June 2022. I applied for indefinite leave to remain in June 2025, but my application was refused because I had not completed five years from the date my refugee permission was granted. I was therefore expecting to apply again in June 2027.

It’s hard to overstate the importance of the turnovers that the UCLA Bruins have forced this season. The team leads the nation with 27 turnovers. Typically, turnovers forced can be a bit streaky, as it often requires a bit of good fortune to force takeaways but the UCLA defense is putting that belief to the test. Defensive coordinator Colin Hitschler has transformed the Bruin defense into a ball-seeking machine and the group hasn't shown many signs of slowing down. UCLA is averaging three turnovers per game this season but forced only one turnover against Illinois last week when Bruin defensive back Scooter Jackson picked off Drake Lindsey.

For the first time since 1971, the Longhorns will wear their home jerseys on the road. UT will wear Burnt Orange at LSU, who traditionally wear white. Texas last wore its home uniform on the road against UCLA at the Los Angeles Colosseum. UCLA also wore its regular powder blue home jersey in the 28-10 Longhorns victory. Wearing your colored jerseys on the road was more common back then. But in the early 1980s, the NCAA changed the rules. In 1982, the NCAA had altered the "jersey rule," requiring teams to wear the school color jerseys for home games. LSU, who traditionally wore white at home, wore purple jerseys for all home games from 1983 to 1994.

A European spacecraft has begun close inspections of an asteroid rammed by NASA four years ago in a planetary defense test. The European Space Agency announced Wednesday that the Hera spacecraft is now studying Didymos and its moonlet Dimorphos from just 15 miles to 18 miles (25 kilometers to 30 kilometers) away. NASA's Dart spacecraft deliberately slammed into little Dimorphos in 2022 to see whether such a defensive move might help save Earth from a killer space rock one day. The impact shortened the moonlet's orbit around Didymos. More importantly, it nudged the moonlet into a slightly different path around the sun.

Today in Boston Celtics history, Frederick Robert Robey extended his contract with the team. The 2027 NFL coach hiring cycle hasn't yet kicked into full gear, but there are plenty of candidates in whom teams will be interested once it does. As every NFL fan knows, that will not last long.
